name: Sea Palace
description: Sea Palace is a Chinese restaurant that floats beside Oosterdokskade, a short walk from Amsterdam Centraal. Its pagoda architecture of stacked green-tiled roofs, red columns and dark balustrades rises through three floors to a roof terrace, and has been a landmark of the city centre for decades.
funFact: Sea Palace describes itself as the first floating restaurant in Europe; about 600 seats are spread over its three floors, and it holds a Bib Gourmand for its Cantonese cooking and dim sum.
pinNotes: Existing mapped restaurant point only; the quay gangway is not surveyed.
